$description: Token proposals for SystemMessage (carbon-labs v12). Moves to packages/themes at graduation, or is dropped if Carbon covers it another way. Values are aliases to Carbon's own tokens where one exists.

icon-alert.$description: The warning glyph on a notice about the conversation. Carbon's $support-warning (#f1c21b) is about 1.7:1 on white, so it cannot carry a glyph at WCAG 1.4.11's 3:1 non-text floor — it is drawn as a filled shape with a dark outline in Carbon's own notifications, which this notice does not have. These are the status yellow's warning accents, solved on the darkest ground each theme declares a status ink on: #836700 at 4.51 on v12 light layer-03 (#EAEBEE), #CEA400 at 7.02 on v12 dark layer-03 (#1E1F21). Both clear 3:1 with room. Falls back to $support-warning.

nonText.why: The glyph carries the alert severity, so it is in scope for WCAG 1.4.11. A transcript notice sits on whatever ground the thread is given — declared rather than inherited through replaces:, because this proposes an ink for one use, not a change to Carbon's own $support-warning. Clearing 3:1 is the whole reason the token exists, so the scope says so and the contrast is checked against it.

$extensions.com.ibm.harness.curve: color.status.yellow accent-on-light-shell (L 0.5277, C 0.1245, H 90) in light; accent-on-dark (L 0.7356, C 0.1736, H 90) in dark.
